key.name: new-note
key.description: Global shortcut that creates a note from anywhere. Set to an empty list to disable it.

key.name: hide-from-taskbar
key.summary: Keep note windows out of the dock and window switcher
key.description: Sticky notes are more like desktop widgets than applications, so by default they are hidden from the dash and Alt-Tab. Mutter exposes skip-taskbar as read-only, so this is attempted rather than guaranteed; if it has no effect on your system, turn it off to avoid the overhead.
